facts.business: Endurance Technologies Limited is a diversified automotive component manufacturer producing braking systems, suspension systems, aluminium die casting, transmission components, alloy wheels, and embedded electronic products for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, four-wheelers, and non-automotive applications across India and Europe.

capacity_or_capex.item: Alloy Wheel plant at AURIC Bidkin
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Commercial production commenced, installed capacity 36 lakh wheels per annum

capacity_or_capex.item: Lithium-ion battery pack plant at Mindewadi, Pune
Capacity at AURIC Shendra for four-wheeler and non-automotive machined castings
ABS and Disc Brakes capacity augmentation at Waluj and Chennai
SMT line expansion for in-house ABS ECU manufacturing and higher BMS volumes
Die casting and machining operations expansion at Chakan
Next-generation Suspension and Brakes R&D centres

guidance_or_targets.statement: Peak annual business potential of the plant for EV and hybrid programmes secured from a large U.S.-based EV OEM
Commercial production for key EV programmes expected to commence
